title: 演化方向頁的選用讀取打開全站錯誤橫幅：擋住所有 hosted 部署

root_cause_and_fix.root_cause: src/management/pages/Lists.tsx EvolutionList called mgmt.evolutionQualification.get().catch(() => null) twice (once in loadEvolutionPrograms and once in a redundant useEffect). Because mgmt.evolutionQualification.get() uses mgmtRead/safeAdapt, an unusable response shape (such as [] or emptyListEnvelope('ancillary') { data: [], items: [] } in e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts) caused safeAdapt to throw 'live adapter contract mismatch (strict mode): adapter returned no data', and strictLiveRead in src/lib/bff-v1/domainReads.ts called liveStatus.reportFallback('strict: ...') before rethrowing, opening the global STRICT TYPED ERROR and FALLBACK DATA banners.
fix: Switched EvolutionList in src/management/pages/Lists.tsx to read qualification once via mgmt.evolutionQualification.getLiveOnly().catch(() => undefined) in loadEvolutionPrograms and removed the duplicate useEffect call.

Updated adaptEvolutionQualificationReport in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to require at least one qualification report field or decision item so unusable object shapes (such as { items: [], meta: {} } or {}) also return null and resolve to undefined through liveOnlyRead/optionalAdapt without reporting fallback.
Preserved paths.mgmtEvolutionQualification and the strict mgmt.evolutionQualification.get contract unchanged.

1_e2e_06_entity_registry_f07_and_wider_f.details: e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts F07 ('renders all 12 registry surfaces from fixture-backed list routes') passes for all 12 registries (including evolution-programs) in 13.0s against the local isolated loopback candidate with e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts completely unchanged (4 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed). Also ran the wider 16-spec Integration Gate fixture suite against the isolated loopback candidate and recorded results below.

2_unusable_qualification_shape_renders_l.details: When /bff/management/evolution-qualification returns an array body [] or an unusable envelope ({ data: [], items: [] }, { items: [], meta: {} }, {}), EvolutionList still renders the evolution programs list, liveStatus remains effective='live' with lastError=undefined, neither STRICT TYPED ERROR nor FALLBACK DATA appears, and the qualification card renders its existing not-evaluated state ('—', 'Not evaluated yet', 0 evaluated, 0 qualified).

3_valid_qualification_report_and_existin.details: A valid qualification report renders policy_version, evaluated_at, evaluated and qualified counts, and failing-criterion counts on the page; existing evolutionQualification adapter tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management.test.ts and contract-drift tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/contract-drift.test.ts stay green.

4_live_only_read_and_optional_adapt_used.details: EvolutionList uses mgmt.evolutionQualification.getLiveOnly() (which goes through liveOnlyRead and optionalAdapt(adaptEvolutionQualificationReport)). The strict mgmt.evolutionQualification.get contract is preserved unchanged, and no new fallback mechanism or per-page liveStatus manipulation was added.

5_component_tests_for_array_body_valid_r.details: Added component tests in src/management/pages/EvolutionProgramsQualification.test.tsx and src/management/pages/ObjectListPage.test.tsx rendering EvolutionList with LiveStatusBanner and TopBar data-source state for both an array body [] and a valid qualification report, asserting banner absence and single qualification request, plus verifying other pages/strict readers keep their strict behavior.
